# AASTeX distribution notice

This repository includes an unchanged subset of the AASTeX 7.0.1 distribution: `aastex701.cls`, `aasjournalv7.bst`, and the official `orcid-ID.png` author-identifier icon. The sample manuscript, sample bibliography, example figure and documentation examples are omitted; the class and bibliography-style source code are not modified. This file records the packaging changes only.

AASTeX is copyright the American Astronomical Society and its credited contributors. It is distributed by the official AASJournals repository under the LaTeX Project Public License version 1.3c; the class permits version 1.3c or later. The complete license is in `LPPL-1.3c.txt`. All notices in the upstream files are retained, including the historical Patrick W. Daly notice in the bibliography style. These files are not licensed under the MIT license of this repository for author-written code.

The complete, unmodified upstream distribution is available at [the official AASJournals repository](https://github.com/AASJournals/AASTeX7), [the complete repository archive](https://github.com/AASJournals/AASTeX7/archive/refs/heads/main.zip), and [CTAN](https://ctan.org/pkg/aastex). The current CTAN entry identifies version 7.0.1. The upstream authors are not responsible for support of this repository.

The ORCID icon is used unmodified solely to display the authors' ORCID identifiers. ORCID and the iD logo are trademarks of ORCID, Inc.; use follows the [ORCID brand guidelines](https://info.orcid.org/brand-guidelines/) and does not imply endorsement.
